name: Hosted Agents — azd-provisioned canary
summary: Long-lived Hosted Agent provisioned by `azd deploy` (via the `azure.ai.agents` extension) whose container code runs a BYOM probe matrix against the APIM AI Gateway from inside Foundry.
description: A pre-provisioned Foundry Hosted Agent registered by `azd` with `host: azure.ai.agent` invokes the Responses API from inside its container using `BYOM_MODEL='{connection}/{deployment}'`. This checks that long-lived hosted agents can call APIM-routed models without paying the cold-start cost of building a container during the feature test.
notes:
Verified end-to-end through the hosted-agent canary after the infra repo has been deployed with `azd deploy`. See `test.py`.

`azd deploy` uses the Azure AI Foundry extension (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/developer/azure-developer-cli/extensions/azure-ai-foundry-extension) to build and push the container to ACR, register the Hosted Agent version, and export `HOSTED_AGENT_NAME_CANARY`. The agent's `agent.yaml` sets `BYOM_MODEL=${AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_STATIC}/${CHAT_MODEL}` and, when configured, `BYOM_MODEL_ANTHROPIC=${AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_ANTHROPIC}/${ANTHROPIC_MODEL}`; each JSON sub-probe must return `ok=true`.
